import re

def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into a single space and strip
    leading and trailing ASCII whitespace.  Preserve all other code points
    including NBSP."""
    # Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace (space, tab, LF, CR, VT, FF)
    stripped = s.strip(' \t\r\n\x0b\x0c')
    # Collapse any remaining run of one or more ASCII whitespace chars to a single space
    collapsed = re.sub(r'[ \t\r\n\x0b\x0c]+', ' ', stripped)
    return collapsed

def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into one space and strip ends."""
    # Replace each ASCII whitespace char (space, tab, LF, CR, vertical tab, form feed) with a single space
    result = []
    prev_was_space = False
    for ch in s:
        if ch in (' ', '\t', '\n', '\r', '\x0b', '\x0c'):
            if not prev_was_space:
                result.append(' ')
                prev_was_space = True
        else:
            result.append(ch)
            prev_was_space = False
    # Strip leading/trailing spaces
    stripped = ''.join(result).strip(' ')
    return stripped
